name: T10b — Host-side driver package inspector and extractor
description:
Depends on: T10a.

Add `runtime/platform/adreno/package.{hpp,cpp}`: inspect and extract a user-supplied driver zip into app-private storage without loading it.
- Read and validate `meta.json` (`schemaVersion`, `name`, `libraryName`, `minApi`, `vendor`, `driverVersion`); accept a plain `libvulkan.so` package only if T10a records that shape.
- Validate the ICD ELF before extraction: ELF64, little-endian, `ET_DYN`, `EM_AARCH64` for `arm64-v8a`, non-empty `.dynsym`, sane size caps.
- Reject zip-slip (absolute or `..` paths), duplicate/overlong entries, encrypted or unsupported compression, and entries over the size/count budget.
- Extract atomically to a staging directory then rename; stable per-driver id; idempotent re-import; delete. Every rejection is a named error; no silent skip and no partial install.
- Use a pinned library for zip/JSON (miniz MIT / libzip BSD-3 / an existing JSON dependency); never hand-write the container or JSON parser. Record the choice and license in `docs/SOURCE_PROVENANCE.md`.

Data: `DriverPackage {id, display_name, vendor, driver_version, min_api, soname, staged_dir}`; `scan_drop_folder()` and `remove()`.

Tests (red first): synthetic zips authored by the test (stored + deflated), a Turnip-shaped `meta.json` package, a plain `libvulkan.so` package, missing/bad `meta.json`, zip-slip, duplicate names, entry-count/size cap, wrong ELF class/machine (`EM_X86_64`, 32-bit), truncated ELF, missing soname. Fixtures are generated bytes; no real driver binary is committed.

Reference discovery (all tasks): before implementing, use `gh search code "<api-or-symbol>"` (add `--extension cpp` for C/C++ work) to find concrete implementations and their projects, then `gh search issues "<api-or-symbol>"` for semantics and regressions. Record the references used.

Specific searches: `gh search code "ZipFileReader" --extension cpp`; `gh search code "EM_AARCH64" --extension cpp`; `gh search code "miniz" --extension cpp`; `gh search issues "zip slip"`; `gh search code "libadrenotools" --extension cpp`.

Refs: PPSSPP `UI/DriverManagerScreen.cpp` (meta.json install flow), libadrenotools `tools/ADPKG.md`, Vita3K `android_driver.cpp`, T9 Android storage. Gotchas: §7A.7, §7E.6.
result:
Added runtime/platform/adreno/package.{hpp,cpp} and a host driver_package_tests suite. The inspector reads a whole zip snapshot, computes the content id as the first 16 hex of SHA-256, validates every entry name (absolute/.. /control/overlong), duplicates, entry count, per-entry/total/archive budgets, encryption and compression support, parses meta.json with nlohmann/json, and validates the ICD as ELF64 LE ET_DYN EM_AARCH64 with a non-empty .dynsym via <elf.h>. Both package shapes are accepted: Turnip-style meta.json with required schemaVersion 1, name and libraryName (soname must name a root .so), or a bare libvulkan.so with exactly one root library. All failures are named: driver_zip_missing/unsupported/slip, driver_entry_duplicate/oversize/name/encrypted, driver_meta_invalid/schema/name, driver_library_missing/ambiguous, driver_elf_class/machine/type/truncated/dynsym, driver_storage_unavailable, driver_id_invalid.

install_driver_zip extracts the same validated snapshot into filesDir-style drivers/<id>/.staging-<id> and renames only after every entry is written; re-import of the same id is idempotent and remove_driver is idempotent. scan_drop_folder returns valid packages plus per-file named errors (case-insensitive .zip). ZIP is handled by miniz 3.1.2 (MIT), JSON by nlohmann/json 3.12.0 (MIT), both vendored byte-identical and pinned with tree digests in dependencies.json; provenance and the SOURCE_PROVENANCE library table were updated. No driver binary or zip is committed.

Tests synthesize zips with miniz and ELF64 headers with no real driver. Coverage: stored+deflated entries, both package shapes, metadata/schema/name/minApi/vendor errors, zip-slip including a patched absolute name, duplicates, overlong names, archive/entry/total/count limits, encrypted and unsupported-method entries, ELF class/machine/type/truncated/empty dynsym, install/re-import/remove, scan sorting/errors, and no staging directory after a failed install. Mutation evidence: disabling the encryption guard changes the encrypted fixture's named error; disabling the path guard accepts zip-slip; both kill the suite for the intended case. Full suite 114/114 green; repository_check PASS (285 files); deps.py verify passes for all eight entries.

References used: gh search code "ZipFileReader" --extension cpp (PPSSPP and other zip reader call sites); gh search code "mz_zip_reader_init_mem" --extension cpp (miniz API usage); gh search code "EM_AARCH64" --extension cpp (ELF machine checks); gh search code "miniz" --extension cpp; gh search issues "zip slip" (path-traversal and extraction-budget failure reports); gh search code "adrenotools_open_libvulkan" --extension cpp (loader call sites). Upstream miniz 3.1.2 release, nlohmann/json v3.12.0 release assets, <elf.h> definitions.

name: T11b — Touch overlay and editable layout
description:
Depends on: T11a.

Touch overlay (native Android View):
- Add `runtime/input/touch_overlay.*` (C++ layout/pointer/edit/JSON model, host-tested) plus a thin `com.gungnir.recomp.input.TouchOverlayView` for Canvas drawing and MotionEvent handling above the SDL surface in landscape. The View asks the model for a pixel snapshot and forwards touches through JNI.
- Controls: floating analog stick (appears under the thumb, follows drags), 8-way d-pad, four face buttons, L/R and START/SELECT. Respect safe-area insets and multiple simultaneous pointer ids; show pressed visuals.
- Track each pointer by id and role so a finger can slide between controls without sticky buttons; release every pointer on ACTION_CANCEL, focus loss and background.
- Editable layout: a Layout/Reset control in the Activity toggles edit mode; drag moves a control, resize changes its radius, positions clamp to the safe screen, reset restores the default. Persist a versioned JSON layout in app-private storage with an atomic temp-file+rename. Missing/corrupt/older layouts fall back to the default with a named log; never crash the overlay.
- Publish the merged touch state to T11a through a JNI `nativeTouchState(buttons, x, y)` call; the C++ core stores it as the Touch source. Make `InputState` thread-safe because the View runs on the UI thread while HLE reads on the SDL thread.
- Host tests: C++ contracts for layout defaults/hit-testing, pointer-id tracking, stick and d-pad deflection, slide-between-controls, drag/resize clamping, JSON round-trip, schema/version handling, corrupt-file fallback and atomic file storage.
- On-device: overlay appears over the app, presses reach the JNI touch state, layout edits survive restart. Haptics are T11c, not this subtask.

Reference set: **TeamGDB/Yakumo (MIT, pinned b61852a)** is the primary behavioral source — `profiles/mhp3rd/host/input/touch_controls.*` (floating stick, `dpad_buttons`, `stick_deflection`, finger roles), `ui/touch_editor.*` (drag/resize/reset) and `tests/touch_controls_tests.cpp`; port the semantics to the C++ model, copy no code, and record provenance. Behavioral references only (GPL; no code or assets copied): PPSSPP (`UI/TouchControlLayoutScreen.*`, pointer capture/analog drag), Dolphin (Android input overlay/hide), RetroArch (overlay hit-testing), Flycast (Android virtual gamepad), reVC/re3 (mobile touch UX). Platform contract: Android `View`/`Canvas`/`MotionEvent`/`WindowInsets` and app-private file I/O.

Red-first rule applies (plan §8.1): tests observed red before implementation; bug fixes start with a reproducing red test.

Reference discovery (all tasks): before implementing, use `gh search code "<api-or-symbol>"` (add `--extension cpp` for C/C++ work) to find concrete implementations and their projects, then `gh search issues "<api-or-symbol>"` for semantics and regressions. Record the references used.

Specific searches: `gh search code "touch_controls" --extension cpp`; `gh search code "touch_editor" --extension cpp`; `gh search code "virtual joystick" --extension cpp`; `gh search issues "Android touch overlay drag resize"`.

Device validation: see `android/AGENTS.md` — emulator is for initial bring-up; physical arm64 phone QA is required at sprint end and recorded in `docs/qa/`. Reproducible emulator: `scripts/android/emulator.sh`.
result:
T11b complete (implementation 1fe90b3, QA 3c0c2c6).

- runtime/input/touch_overlay.*: host-testable layout/pointer/edit model. Defaults for floating stick, 8-way d-pad, Cross/Circle/Square/Triangle, L/R, Start/Select; safe-area-normalized placements; pointer roles by id with slide-between-controls; floating stick origin follows past reach; edit drag/resize clamps to the safe box; reset. Versioned JSON (version 1) with Older/Corrupt statuses that leave the previous layout intact.
- runtime/input/touch_layout_store.*: writes a sibling .tmp then renames over the target; missing/older/corrupt are named, a failed write removes the temp and leaves the previous file. A load error is reported as corrupt rather than missing.
- Android: com.gungnir.recomp.input.TouchOverlayView draws a pixel snapshot with Canvas and forwards MotionEvents through JNI; Controls button toggles edit, long-press resets; onPause/focus-loss release and save. Drivers button moved bottom-right so it no longer covers R. SELECT label shortened to SEL to fit.
- JNI publishes the touch mask/analog through the T11a InputState. InputState now has a mutex because the View is on the UI thread and HLE reads on the SDL thread. Touch gestures route to edit_* while editing; touch_up now ends an edit drag.
- Red-first: tests/input/touch_overlay_tests.cpp and tests/test_touch_overlay.py were added before touch_overlay.* existed; the first configure failed on the missing touch_overlay.cpp, then the contracts went green. The suite covers hit-testing, multi-touch, slide, stick clamp, d-pad diagonals, edit clamp, JSON round-trip, version/corrupt fallback and atomic store round-trip. Final suite 135/135; Android clean-checkout APK gate passes; repository_check PASS (318 files).
- Device QA on M2102K1AC (arm64, API 34), app 1fe90b3: overlay draws; temporary JNI diagnostics observed touch_down buttons=0x4000 (Cross); Cross/stick/d-pad visuals verified; Cross moved to cx=0.7389886379/cy=0.6332540512 and survived force-stop/restart; long-press reset restored cx=0.82/cy=0.74/radius=0.05; corrupt file logged touch_layout_corrupt_default and defaulted; three cold boots FRAME_OK at 3063x1335 on the system Adreno driver. Report docs/qa/2026-10-31-t11b-touch-overlay.md.

References: TeamGDB/Yakumo (MIT, pinned b61852a) touch_controls.* and ui/touch_editor.* for floating-stick, dpad_buttons/stick_deflection and drag/resize semantics (port, no code copied); PPSSPP touch-layout/pointer capture, Dolphin Android overlay, RetroArch hit-testing, Flycast virtual gamepad as behavioral references only (GPL, no code or assets copied); Android View/Canvas/MotionEvent/WindowInsets contract. Gaps: touch haptics are T11c; overlay hide on gamepad is T11d; game/synthetic-fixture navigation is T13.
